description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single hybrid attacks at Cap Break Level 1, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], Cap Break Level 1, Semi-Prime Mode, Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Fire Ability Boost, Dualcast Fire, Zero Hone Cost to Fire Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 4 single-target Fire/NE hybrid attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, h25 heal & Fire Ability Damage +30% for 2 turns to party, 50% DEF/RES Pierce 2 & Quick ATB 1 to user
Semi-Prime Mode: [MAG/MND/DEF +50%, Instant Cast & chases Black Magic/White Magic abilities with 10% Stoneskin to party] for 5 seconds to user
